ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 75% high-intensity (cream-white) to 25% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel distribution across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity field across the central and upper lobe regions; a large, irregular low-intensity cluster in the mid-left lobe; a dense concentration of low-intensity linear and amorphous markings in the lower-right lobe; a central dark wedge originating from the peduncle attachment point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 135 degrees; depth is approximately 5% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged serration along the continuous boundary; pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels occurring at irregular intervals, most pronounced on the medial sections of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering into acute, upward-pointing tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast, multi-chromatic (tan/white) nodes localized exclusively at the distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions; includes multiple horizontal rake marks on the right lobe and several vertical/diagonal scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the fluke tips; prominent rake mark scarring across the lower sections of both lobes.
